remarks: Welcome to Indian River Green! Located in a private community of 20 Townhouse Style Units in the desirable Saugatuck neighborhood with walk to train convenience. Beautiful Open Concept design with custom kitchen which features skylights, vaulted ceiling, corian countertops and tile backsplash. The dining room has built -in bookcases and opens to the spacious Living Room which boasts a fireplace, built-ins, vaulted ceiling and sliders that access your private patio. Private half bath with laundry along with sunlit entry foyer complete the main level. As you walk up the light and bright staircase you are greeted to the Primary Bedroom Suite which showcases a high ceiling, sliders to a wonderful upper balcony/deck and beautiful full bath. The second Bedroom has a vaulted ceiling with an ensuite full bathroom. A wrap around entry porch and private 1 car garage complete this attractive home. Just minutes to the heart of downtown shopping and beaches with easy access to the train and I-95. Enjoy all that the Westport lifestyle has to offer. The perfect place to call home!
